text:
alex: Quick async standup — sprint handoff for roadmap items.
What I did: merged the v2 routing spec PR, ran batching perf benchmarks, updated the rollout plan in Confluence (https://confluence.redwood.ai/roadmaps/v2-routing).
Blockers: waiting on infra to confirm Dedicated capacity numbers for the canary window; SSO test is flaking intermittently.
Today: address infra feedback, pair with @tara on canary cutoff, ping QE for smoke tests.

tara: Thanks — I can sync with infra at 15:30. I’ll own the canary cutoff decision if infra gives numbers. For QE, @ben can you take smoke ownership?

ben: on it. I’ll run the end-to-end smoke and add a quick regression prompt set. ETA EOD.

mei: left comments on the spec PR about telemetry fields — need request_id and model_variant in traces (small change). Also +1 to canary gating rule (fail fast on perf regressions).

chris: code review ping @alex — left inline on the handler near KV cache. Quick fix: bump buffer_size to 32 (was 16). Also suggest a small comment on why eviction is LRU.

alex: pushing a fix for the buffer_size now — will tag the PR. Also updated the rollout policy doc to include fallback rules.

alex: added checklist snippet to the rollout doc:
```
- Update canary infra slot (dedicated pool)
- Run perf harness: throughput & p95
- QE: smoke + prompt regression set
- Observability: add trace tags + request_id
- Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback
```

ben: QE notes from local run: two prompt truncation regressions under the low-memory quantized profile. Filing issues: RD-2217, RD-2218. Not blocking canary but want to monitor.

tara: prioritization question: if infra capacity is delayed, do we (A) fallback to smaller model_variant for 24h or (B) delay launch until dedicated is available? React :thumbsup: for fallback, :hourglass_flowing_sand: to delay.

mei: :thumbsup: fallback seems safer for customers.

ben: :thumbsup: fallback + monitor.

chris: :hourglass_flowing_sand: leaning to delay to avoid edge regressions, but ok with fallback if we have strict monitoring.

alex: consensus leans to fallback with strict observability and rollback. I’ll update the rollout policy to prefer model_variant fallback and set a 24h window. I’ll also notify sales and CSMs.

alex: @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary deploy for 20:00 UTC (20% traffic) and attach the perf harness snapshot?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 20:00 UTC. Perf snapshot: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/1812345678/perf-snapshot. Will post status when done.

alex: thanks team. If QE flags anything blocking, drop the issue number here and I’ll pause the rollout. Otherwise I’ll push the policy update by 17:30.

ben: will update RD-2217/2218 with logs and labels.

chris: left one more tiny nit on the PR, non-blocking.

mei: will re-approve once telemetry fields are in.

alex: great — closing async standup. Ping me for any cross-team escalations. :shipit:
